title: Analysts’ Price Target Changes for August, 27th (AAPL, AFN, ALNY, ATD.B, B4B3, CRL, FL, GE, HIBB, KXS)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Aug 27th, 2018 // No Comments
Analysts’ price target changes for Monday, August 27th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $225.00 target price by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:

Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc Class B (TSE:ATD.B) had its target price increased by Barclays PLC from C$72.00 to C$73.00.

Foot Locker (NYSE:FL) had its target price lowered by Credit Suisse Group AG from $62.00 to $56.00. Credit Suisse Group AG currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
General Electric (NYSE:GE) was given a $11.00 price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.

Kinaxis (TSE:KXS) had its target price increased by CIBC from C$101.00 to C$107.00.
Liberty Latin America Ltd Class C (NASDAQ:LILAK) had its price target cut by Citigroup Inc from $29.00 to $27.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
LexinFintech (NASDAQ:LX) had its target price cut by Bank of America Corp from $21.00 to $18.00. Bank of America Corp currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) was given a $125.00 price target by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Orla Mining (CVE:OLA) was given a C$2.00 price target by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Pure Multi-Family REIT (CVE:RUF.UN) had its price target reduced by CIBC from C$7.75 to C$7.50.
Pure Multi-Family REIT (CVE:RUF.UN) had its price target trimmed by Royal Bank of Canada from C$8.25 to C$7.50. They currently have an outperform rating on the stock.
Pure Multi-Family REIT (CVE:RUF.UN) had its target price lowered by Industrial Alliance Securities from C$8.00 to C$7.00.
Sangoma Technologies (CVE:STC) had its price target boosted by Cormark from C$1.75 to C$2.25. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Molson Coors Brewing Co Class B (NYSE:TAP) had its price target trimmed by Citigroup Inc from $80.00 to $78.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Teladoc (NYSE:TDOC) had its target price boosted by KeyCorp from $74.00 to $90.00. KeyCorp currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
Tilly’s (NYSE:TLYS) was given a $17.00 target price by analysts at B. Riley. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
TMAC Resources (TSE:TMR) was given a C$8.50 price target by analysts at National Bank Financial. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
